STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give different Java versions for running or building GATK:
- Java 17 is needed to run or build GATK, per the GATK README [gatk_readme#h001]
- A Java 8 JDK is required to run or build GATK, per the legacy build notes for GATK v4.2 (synthetic fixture) [fx_gatk_java]
The context does not say which version applies.
